note: One creature at three scales plus what stops it. Five records, and the scaling is the content: a single moth, a cloud, and the thing the cloud comes out of.

creatures.name: Cindermoth
unmodelled: One moth. Included so a swarm's arithmetic can be checked against it

creatures.name: Cindermoth Cloud
unmodelled: Swarm: shares space with other creatures and cannot be grappled or shoved
Roughly two hundred moths; killing individuals does nothing

creatures.name: Cindermoth Brood-Trunk
unmodelled: Speed 0: it is the burnt tree the brood lives in
Releases a fresh cloud every third round until destroyed

conditions.name: cindermoth-ember-caught
conditions.description: Embers in the hair and clothing. The creature is more concerned with that than with fighting.

items.name: Cindermoth Smother-Blanket
items.description: Wet felt. Thrown over someone who is on fire, or someone who is not yet.
unmodelled: It heals the burns and leaves the embers where they are, which is the trade
